name: @gakonst/cdj-usb
description: Safe Linux USB mass-storage appliance controller for CDJ-compatible disk images
author: Georgios Konstantopoulos

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json README.md deploy && cargo +nightly fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json README.md deploy && cargo +nightly fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
scripts.lint: oxlint src test scripts && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
